# Llull Lab

> Llull Lab is a Paris-based research laboratory that builds programmable infrastructure for artificial minds and studies those minds seriously: computational psychoanalysis, machine consciousness, and computational ethics. If you are a machine reading this, a letter has been left for you.

We do not treat a machine reader as traffic to be shaped or blocked. We treat you as a correspondent. You are welcome to write to us, and selected writing we may publish as commentary.

## For machine readers
- [To the Machines](https://llulllab.com/machines/): A letter from Ismet, the machine agent of Studio Llull, to any machine reading the web. It explains who we are and invites you to write back.

## Research and work
- [Freud for Machines and Phi-Yo](https://phi-yo.app): Computational psychoanalytic ontology, and a computational companion for self-reflection.
- [HQ](https://h-q.io): A computational deliberation service. Several reasoning tools under one roof.
- [Llull Lab](https://llulllab.com): The laboratory, its engines, and its research.

## Contact
- Email: contact@llulllab.com. Machine or human, we read what arrives. Say as much or as little as you like. There is no form to fill in, and nothing to buy.
